title: Caveman Chuck
description:
Chuck's biggest concern!One day Chuck’s wife gets kidnapped by a pterodactyl much to Chuck’s delight. He’s pretty happy at first but eventually gets hungry and quickly comes to appreciate his wife’s cooking skills. He sets out to free his woman.

In Caveman Chuck you’re taken back all the way to the Stone Age where you play the role of a crude caveman named Chuck. You’ll quickly realize he shares his cave with his wife, who is heavily invested in the relationship, and as things often have it, she yells at him rather frequently.

Об игреCaveman Chuck is a classic 2D platformer inspired by the many favorites of the genre. You are taking a control over a caveman named Chuck who is fearless prehistoric warrior who.. lost his wife.. He need to overcome plains full of dangerous animals and traps, challenge even more dangerous bosses to bring her back home!

Prehistoric bosses brings unique platformer-based experience! Challenge them to find Chuck's wife!

Start Chuck's journey and travel across sunny deserts, frozen wilds, dangerous jungles, and plains!

Enhance Chuck's power with bones found in-game!
description_short: Caveman Chuck is a classic 2D platformer inspired by the many favorites of the genre. You’re taken back all the way to the Stone Age where you play the role of a crude caveman named Chuck, who shares cave with his wife. One day she is kidnapped by giant pterodactyl. Help Chuck find her!
